agentEvidence.exportRecordMatchScope: all 24 native part records; source/canvas wrapper checked independently against protected KRA/XML and texture bytes

feedbackEvidence.meaning: This fresh run has no user screenshot, feedback or diagnostic coordinates in its production inputs; fixed probes are independent acceptance evidence only.

kraTextures.limitation: All 24 complete part records match the successful native Krita result; wrapper source/canvas, XML identity, bounds and byte hashes checked independently. No separate native per-layer pixel reprojection was performed.

geometry.mirrorMeasurementLimit: Diagnostic of paired composed reflection; dense geometry and actual mirror images are reviewed separately.

reference.verification: Unchanged original frame/video SHA and original selection manifest; no new frame selection or video generation.

sourceSvgRaster.derivation: Rasterized original SVG bytes, no prediction or contour changes; display reference only.

visualEvidence.acceptanceRule: Inspect actual final face coverage and upper alpha silhouette against full prediction and original bang skin window. Closed SVG paths and small trace residuals are insufficient; all visual checks remain pending owner/user approval.

coverageAndIntegrationLimit: Actual full-face silhouette, unchanged completion, static KRA/video hair windows and X mirror/halves rendered. No hair motion or new-X to existing-Y/XY integration was created or accepted; supplied old diagonal sequences are diagnostic only. Small trace residuals do not prove actual forehead completion or video fidelity.
